recipe.title: Chicken Curry Recipe

ingredients.name: yogurt
ingredients.prep_note: or 1½ tbsp cashew butter or 12 cashews powdered & pureed with ¼ cup water

ingredients.name: Kashmiri red chili powder
ingredients.prep_note: or smoked paprika (½ tsp for less spicy)

ingredients.name: garam masala
ingredients.prep_note: (½ tsp more if needed, adjust to taste)

steps.text: On a medium flame, heat oil in a deep pan. Add the whole spices - bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves & green cardamoms.
steps.label: Bloom spices

steps.text: Stir in the chopped onions and chilies. Saute until deep golden in color, for 7 to 8 mins.
steps.label: Saute onions

steps.text: Add ginger garlic paste and saute till you get a nice aroma, for about a minute.
steps.label: Add paste

steps.text: Then add tomatoes, turmeric and salt. Mix well and cook until the tomatoes turn soft & mushy.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes

steps.text: Turn down the heat to low, Stir in the yogurt (or cashew paste), red chili powder, garam masala & coriander powder.
steps.label: Add spices

steps.text: Cook on low heat, until the mixture smells good and aromatic.
steps.label: Reduce and aroma

steps.text: Add chicken and coriander leaves. Fry on a medium heat till the chicken turns white or pale in color. This takes around 3 mins.
steps.label: Brown chicken
steps.doneness_cue: turns white or pale in color

steps.text: Cover and cook on a low heat for 3 to 4 minutes. This step is very important as the chicken absorbs all the flavors of the spices.
steps.label: Brief simmer
steps.attention_cue: Cover and cook on a low heat for 3 to 4 minutes.
steps.doneness_cue: absorbs all the flavors of the spices

steps.text: Meanwhile in a separate pot, heat up 1 cup water. Using cold water most times toughens the chicken so it is good to use hot water.
steps.label: Heat water

steps.text: Pour hot water just enough (about ½ cup) to make a thick gravy. As you cook, chicken lets out plenty of moisture, depending on that add more water.
steps.label: Add water

steps.text: Cover and cook on a medium flame till the chicken is soft cooked and the curry/gravy turns thick. When the chicken is cooked completely it will fall off the bone easily.
steps.label: Cook through
steps.attention_cue: Cover and cook on a medium flame till the chicken is soft cooked and the curry/gravy turns thick.
steps.doneness_cue: will fall off the bone easily

steps.text: Taste the curry & add more salt if needed. You can also add another ½ tsp garam masala at this stage if you feel it is less in flavors.
steps.label: Adjust seasoning

steps.text: Lastly garnish with coriander leaves, cover and off the heat. Serve chicken curry with butter naan or jeera rice.
steps.label: Finish & serve
